title: The space of n-covectors on ℝ^P is finite-dimensional
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, the real vector space Covector (Euclid P) n = Λⁿ(ℝ^P) of continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P), with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication, is finite-dimensional over ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), FiniteDimensional ℝ (Covector (Euclid P) n)
